name: base-guarded-trader
description: A Claude Agent SDK agent on Base: the Sato Kit's tools run as an in-process MCP server with an approval hook, and every intent is quoted, prepared, simulated and checked by a policy pre-flight that explains every refusal. Fixture mode drives it with a scripted turn list and starts no model. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key, or on Base Sepolia with a managed wallet.
